periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Vertically oriented, approximately 75-85 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovals with a high height-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the inferior point extending significantly below the horizontal midline of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad, shallow U-shape across the posterior edge of the scapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick, occupying approximately 30-35% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap, approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, semicircular curvature at the apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced reddish-brown fur coloration in the lower ventral/perineal region.
